reason: The README describes a DSH profile bundle whose primary purpose is persistent, workspace-scoped memory, persona context injection, session recall, and background consolidation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于文件的分层记忆、工作区上下文注入、会话召回和后台整合能力。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with layered file-backed memory, workspace context injection, session recall, and background consolidation.

capabilities: Reads and writes scoped Markdown memory and persona files under the active DSH home
Injects memory, persona, and workspace context into prompts
Performs background consolidation of eligible session context
Searches prior sessions using semantic ranking with full-text fallback
Provides a settings card and bundled usage skill
